questions.question: What did a man of God prophesy against the altar at Bethel?
options: That a blessing would rest on all who worshiped
That a famine would strike for seven years
That a future king named Josiah would defile it
That a great harvest would fill the land
questions.answer: That a future king named Josiah would defile it

questions.question: What happened to the man of God for disobeying God on his way home?
options: He was struck blind for a time
He was richly rewarded by God
He was killed by a lion
questions.answer: He was killed by a lion

questions.question: King Jeroboam's hand withered when he tried to seize the man of God.
The man of God foretold that a king named _____ would one day defile the altar.
A _____ killed the disobedient man of God on the road.
